name: video_music
description: Scores a clip with generated music and mixes it in. `mixMode` decides what happens to the existing audio: `none` keeps it at full volume, `lower` ducks the music under it, `remove` strips it. Clip must be 3-300s. Sound effects instead → `video_soundfx`. A standalone track with no video → `audio_music_generate`. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation to score. Between 3 and 300 seconds.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

mixMode.description: `none` (default) keeps the original audio, `lower` ducks the music under it, `remove` strips it.

prompt.description: Optional description of the music, e.g. "slow lo-fi piano, melancholic".

trimSeconds.description: Optional: score only this window instead of the whole clip.
